answer: Time-locked work history is the only part that holds. An identity claims at most 12 graded tasks per epoch and each claim unlocks after 40 minutes of continuous signing, so burst capacity buys nothing. Auditors rotate from a pool reseeded every epoch, which keeps a farm from learning whose pulse it must satisfy. One operator spun up 300 identities to clear a trellis of tasks, hit the cap at 12 each, and the forge that backdated his timestamps became the evidence against him.
